project: Wuxia Life P92 Medical Endgame Design-First Contract
description: Design-first contract for medical_sage_healer endgame / final legacy stage (60+). Define endgame direction, 6 branches (2 variants × 3 choices per late-life branch), contract, validation shape, and GO/NO-GO assessment. Must be LIGHTWEIGHT: 1 echo event + expression updates only if GO.

userStories.title: Audit medical endgame prerequisites
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a prerequisite audit for the medical endgame stage so P92 starts from the real gating surfaces and not from assumptions.
acceptanceCriteria: Inventory all medical route flags, markers, events, expressions (bridge + entry + on-ramp + pressure + payoff + late-life)
Document 6 late-life branch state differences (stats + flags + identity) across 2 variants × 3 choices
Identify what exists before endgame and what can be reused
Assess reuse potential of existing P19 endgame echo system and P80/P81 renown endgame pattern
Output docs/test-reports/p92-medical-endgame-prerequisite-audit.md
No runtime behavior changes
userStories.notes: 6 branches = more complex than renown endgame (3 branches). 2 variants (compassionate/pragmatic) × 3 choices each. Zero runtime changes — design-only stage.

userStories.title: Lock P92 scope contract
userStories.description: As a planner, I want a scope contract so P92 stays design-first and does not slip into partial implementation.
acceptanceCriteria: Define P92 scope: gap audit, direction design, endgame contract, proof shape, closure
Define allowed layers: docs, contract, targeted proof planning
Define forbidden items: runtime wiring, new framework, bulk content wave, second route, multi-event arc, stat changes
Define lightweight constraint: max 1 echo event + expression updates only
Output docs/test-reports/p92-medical-endgame-scope-contract.md
userStories.notes: Scope guardrails: boundedness, flavor preservation, 6-branch differentiation, GO-NO-GO. Quality-first priority order.

userStories.title: Design endgame direction (GO / NO-GO assessment)
userStories.description: As a designer, I want a clear assessment of whether medical endgame is worth doing, and if so, what direction it takes.
acceptanceCriteria: Assess whether endgame is needed after late-life: does late-life already provide sufficient closure?
If GO: define endgame core positioning — life review echo? legacy finalization? natural death culmination?
If NO-GO: define stopping point (late-life as medical route end) and rationale
Determine whether 6 late-life branches need distinct endgames or unified echo
Define essential difference between endgame and late-life (not 'more content' but 'final culmination feel')
Document conclusion in design document
userStories.notes: Verdict: CONDITIONAL_GO. Core direction: Medical Legacy Echo (医名身后事) — 世人如何记住这位医者. 2 legacy axes: Compassionate = spiritual/healing (薪火相传), Pragmatic = social/medical (医名远播). 6 distinct variants. Perspective shift: first-person life → third-person memory.

userStories.title: Design six endgame branches (if GO)
userStories.description: As a designer, I want six distinct endgame branches (one per late-life branch) so medical endgame leverages the 6-branch structure for meaningful differentiation — if endgame is worth doing.
acceptanceCriteria: Design Comp-A (最后仁心 / 燃尽自己) endgame: core narrative + trigger + player experience
Design Comp-B (从容自在 / 颐养天年) endgame: core narrative + trigger + player experience
Design Comp-C (仁心传承 / 桃李满天下) endgame: core narrative + trigger + player experience
Design Prag-A (人走茶凉 / 失势跌落) endgame: core narrative + trigger + player experience
Design Prag-B (逍遥自在 / 云游四方) endgame: core narrative + trigger + player experience
Design Prag-C (德高望重 / 一代名医) endgame: core narrative + trigger + player experience
Six branches have meaningfully different expressions, not reskinned
Each branch has tavern-born medical healer flavor adaptation
Define endgame as single echo event vs choice event (recommend single auto echo with 6 variants)
If NO-GO, mark as skipped with rationale
Document conclusion in design document
userStories.notes: 6 branches = 2× renown endgame complexity. Compassionate = body/spirit axis endgame; Pragmatic = social/position axis endgame. Must maintain variant differentiation.

userStories.title: Define medical endgame contract
userStories.description: As a designer, I want an explicit endgame contract so P93 knows exactly what flags, gates, events, and player-facing meanings must be closed — if endgame is worth doing.
acceptanceCriteria: Define endgame checkpoint, required flags, gate acceptance
Define endgame event structure (echo type, recommend auto with 6 variants)
Define stat changes (recommend none), identity marker, expression differences per branch
Define at least 2 endgame-specific player-facing signals
Clarify difference between endgame vs late-life vs generic P19 endgame echo
Preserve tavern-born medical healer flavor
Define age range (60-65? 65-70?)
If NO-GO, mark as skipped with rationale
Write contract to docs/PRD/p92-medical-endgame-contract.md
userStories.notes: Contract LOCKED at end of this story. P93 implementation strictly follows this contract. 6 branch markers + shared checkpoint + identity flag.

userStories.title: Define P93 validation shape (if GO)
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the P93 validation shape fixed in advance so playable endgame work is judged against explicit proof and regression expectations — if endgame is worth doing.
acceptanceCriteria: Define targeted proof chain nodes (late-life → endgame → expression changes)
All 6 branches have core node verification
Define regression test minimum assertions (event wiring, 6 branches, variant differentiation, no regression)
Define what evidence counts as endgame closed
No full lifetime exhaust required
Define no-regression boundary for P83/P84/P85/P87/P89/P91
If NO-GO, mark as skipped with rationale
userStories.notes: Expanded from renown endgame pattern for 6 branches + 2-variant differentiation. ~30-40 regression assertions expected.

userStories.title: Produce P92 closure report
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a closure report that locks the medical endgame design-first contract and either hands off a bounded implementation target to P93 or explicitly stops the medical route at late-life.
acceptanceCriteria: Output docs/test-reports/p92-medical-endgame-closure-report.md
Summarize prerequisite audit, scope contract, endgame direction assessment, branch design (if GO), contract (if GO), validation shape (if GO)
Clarify boundary with P93 (if GO) or define stopping point (if NO-GO)
List deferred larger medical-expansion items
State whether endgame stage is worth implementing (GO / NO-GO)
If GO: state explicit lightweight constraint
If NO-GO: explain why medical route culminates at late-life and why that's better
userStories.notes: Closure and GO/NO-GO for P93 medical endgame implementation stage. 7/7 stories = complete.
